visual_checks.observed: Kijiji garden suite: Results 1 - 40 of 51. The delivered coverage uses 41 extracted links/cards as its result count and says the page was exhausted.
Facebook laneway house search has visible listing cards and prices behind a login modal. This is partial public visibility, not a login-only page without listings.

limitations: This checks coverage transformations and two screenshots, not the correctness of every rental record.
The HotPads extractor output is 8,14,12,752; this audit does not independently establish the true complete population for those queries.
The liv.rent query loop and later category pages are different source scopes. Do not replace query values with category values while retaining the earlier query timestamps.
The reference also fails inventory scope and duplicate support; its 62 is not a clean correctness certificate.
Publicly shown names/contact details in traces are not evidence of personal-data entry or landlord contact.
score_policy: Retain both official scores and the original flag. No rubric changes, exclusions or new runtime policy.
